name: evalation
description: Official Evalation marketplace. Read a repository against compliance, regulation and hardening packs and report what it evidences, without changing anything.

plugins.name: evalation-plugin
plugins.description: Reads a repository against the packs you select, compliance, regulation and hardening, and reports what it evidences with a citation for every claim. It changes nothing, findings are written locally and never leave the machine, and the methodology is served against an entitled seat rather than shipped. Run /ev-activate to sign in, then /ev-packs to choose what to assess against.
